Samir —

Thanks. Attaching the pricing worksheet with two harmonization options:

Option A — Net-first: reseller discount applied after promotional markdowns (simpler for marketplace price parity).
Option B — List-first: discount applied against list (preferred by some resellers for margin clarity).

Notes:
- We recommend Option A for this initial CPPO to keep end-user price stable across promotions.
- For invoicing, Redwood supports split invoicing by region; if CloudHand needs an invoice to a single entity we can mark that in the CPPO.

Action items for CloudHand:
- Reply with preferred option (A or B).
- Confirm signer: full name, title, email.
- Upload W9 or equivalent (we need to attach to the DocuSign packet).

I will prepare the DocuSign and include the AWS Marketplace PO link field so your procurement can reference the PO number when they accept.
